versions.changelog: Add --output-format json to all commands, enhance security model docs, add integration test docs. Addresses ClawHub scanner findings.

First ClawdHub release. coding-pm turns your OpenClaw agent into a PM/QA that manages Claude Code as a background engineer. Send "/dev Add JWT auth" and walk away - it plans, executes, tests, and reports back. Highlights: 5-phase workflow (explore, plan review, execute, test, merge), non-blocking background execution, human-in-the-loop approval gates, 3-layer acceptance testing, git worktree isolation, concurrent tasks, pure SKILL.md with zero scripts.
